reviews.title: It was good.
reviews.text: As much as I understand how to keep kids safe on this app, I feel like removing the feature with talking to other people when your under 18 wasn’t necessary. As a younger person myself, those people I talked to brought me joy, and it hurts to see i cannot talk to them anymore, and it’s not fair. It’s been around 2 and a half years since I seen or talked to them, and it also kind of hurts to know that there hasn’t been any sign of this changing. This app seems very kid like and I know there are thousands of kids out there that saw the ad, pressed download and wanted to see how things were going, and to talk with their fans, it actually makes them feel like a celebrity. I felt that way with how many people loved me, but now it feels kinda off. Please change it so that the younger people can talk and join party and karaoke rooms freely again, and maybe my ratings will go higher. Another note, I understand many other reviews were talking about children wanting to see stuff that weren’t exactly kid friendly, however those children should be reported, not make a full update on every under 18 with some of the kids who just wanted to make friends can’t chat to them anymore.

reviews.title: Disgustingly unsafe for kids
reviews.text: As far as functionality goes, the app works great. But it’s full of fake users (AI bots) who will comment on your covers and act like real users; the false validation is really harmful. How am I supposed to get feedback from the community when the only ones interacting with a video are robots? I find it disgusting. Worse is the total lack of moderation. I joined a chatroom so I could ask real users questions and the people in the chatroom were making constant vulgar sexual references and one user was even talking about being a pdf. It was completely serious, not some twisted joke. On the outside the chat looked completely friendly to children and once you leave, all evidence of misconduct you witnessed is permanently deleted. I also didn’t see a way to report any of this. The 9+ rating on this app is a joke, do not let your kids on here. There are too many predators and no moderation against them, despite the app claiming to protect minors. Let’s not even mention their sketchy privacy policy, they’re very likely using your voice to train their AI models
